scope: Public-source registry for sanitary sewer pump-station (EBAS) discovery. Source eligibility is distinct from facility identity and denominator completeness.

sources.name: Estaciones de Bomba de Aguas Usadas
sources.reason: Object-level official GIS layer explicitly names wastewater pump stations and exposes facility-name and identifier fields, but complete feature retrieval/count and temporal/operator scope are not yet certified.

sources.authority: Autoridad de Acueductos y Alcantarillados via Puerto Rico GIS download portal
sources.name: Infraestructura Acueductos y Sanitaria
sources.reason: Official portal describes a 2015 AAA sanitary and potable infrastructure file geodatabase; archive bytes/layer inventory are not available in the bounded repository/library surfaces used by this execution.

sources.name: AAA_v10_N
sources.reason: Exposed sanitary layers are gravity sewer and pumping/force-main lines; no sanitary pump-station point layer is exposed in this service.

sources.name: Parque de Bomba
sources.reason: Generic pump infrastructure cannot be equated with sanitary sewer pump stations without wastewater-specific source semantics.

sources.name: PRIDCO
sources.reason: AAA_bomba and related fields describe utility context for PRIDCO features, not a facility-level sanitary-pump-station registry.

sources.name: PRASA FY2024 North Region CIP Projects
sources.temporal_scope: FY2024 report with project completion dates through 2026
sources.reason: Explicitly names real EBAS in rehabilitation/generator projects but project selection is not an all-facility denominator.

sources.name: Plan Fiscal Certificado de 2025 para la AAA
sources.reason: Defines EBAS as sanitary sewer pumping station and explicitly references Maunabo and Guardarrayas, but it is a strategic/project document, not an asset registry.

blocking_conditions: Complete query/count of EBAS_SRC_SIGE_CALIDAD_AMBIENTE_L5 not retrieved in this execution environment.
